incidents.name: Compound (Comptroller COMP distribution)
incidents.notes: Unitroller: Proposal 062 (executed 2021-09-29T20:24:08Z) shipped a Comptroller implementation with a broken COMP distribution comparison; drained the next day. The Unitroller is a Compound-fork proxy that announces implementation changes with NewImplementation(address,address), not EIP-1967 Upgraded.

sources.ref: onchain review (RPC only): Unitroller 0x3d9819210A31b4961b30EF54bE2aeD79B9c9Cd3B created 2019-05-07T01:07:17Z at block 7710671. Compound-fork proxy: eth_getLogs for EIP-1967 Upgraded (topic 0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b) over [7710671, 13326968] returns 0 logs; implementation changes are announced by NewImplementation(address,address) (topic 0xd604de94d45953f9138079ec1b82d533cb2160c906d1076d1f7ed54befbca97a) emitted by the Unitroller itself. Exactly 11 such events in the window: 2019-05-07T01:08:08Z -> 0x62f18c451af964197341d3c86d27e98c41bb8fcc, 2019-05-08T22:50:18Z -> 0x178053c06006e67e09879c09ff012ff9d263df29, 2019-10-23T17:01:55Z -> 0xf592ef673057a451c49c9433e278c5d59b56132c, 2020-03-16T17:23:56Z -> 0x97bd4cc841fc999194174cd1803c543247a014fe, 2020-06-15T18:21:43Z -> 0x9d0a0443ff4bb04391655b8cd205683d9fa75550, 2020-07-02T19:02:42Z -> 0xaf601cbff871d0be62d18f79c31e387c76fa0374, 2020-09-13T15:12:02Z -> 0x7b5e3521a049c8ff88e6349f33044c6cc33c113c, 2020-12-10T17:03:56Z -> 0x7d47d3f06a9c10576bc5dc87cefbf3288f96ea04, 2020-12-26T14:29:17Z -> 0xbe7616b06f71e363a310aa8ce8ad99654401ead7, 2021-07-06T16:57:38Z -> 0x75442ac771a7243433e033f3f8eab2631e22938f, and 2021-09-29T20:24:08Z (block 13322798, tx 0xc5098f8fb149262d7f26d32c0642e0e8bee5383d9df9c4988070f63a23cb9912) -> 0x374abb8ce19a73f2c4efad642bda76c797f19233, which is Proposal 062. Cross-checked against storage: the Unitroller's comptrollerImplementation lives in slot 2 (UnitrollerAdminStorage: admin, pendingAdmin, comptrollerImplementation, pendingComptrollerImplementation) and a binary search of eth_getStorageAt over [7710671, 13326968] puts its last change at exactly block 13322798, ts 1632947048, value 0x374abb8ce19a73f2c4efad642bda76c797f19233 - identical to the last event. Stored lastChangeTimestamp 1632947048 and codeAgeSeconds 56152 are CONFIRMED unchanged; only the basis wording is corrected (upgradeEventCount set to 0 because the 11 events are NewImplementation, not EIP-1967 Upgraded).

exploit tx backfilled and verified onchain (block 13324198): the widely documented 91,170 COMP (~$27M) single claimComp call at 2021-09-30T01:38:26Z. The over-distribution was permissionless with no single attack tx - Proposal 062 executed at block 13322798 (tx 0xc5098f8fb149262d7f26d32c0642e0e8bee5383d9df9c4988070f63a23cb9912) and several smaller over-large claims preceded this canonical exploit-scale one
